panels.caption: Somewhere in the galaxy, on a purple-and-yellow planet called Flummoxprap, lived creatures unknown to the rest of the universe.
panels.alt: Purple-and-yellow Flummoxprap hangs in space, its hills dotted with little gray rocks.

panels.caption: They were the Yips. Their streets wound up hills, down hills, and around hills that probably did not need going around.
panels.alt: Smiling robed Yips shuffle along winding yellow streets through purple hills and gray rock homes.

panels.caption: Homes were rocks. Shops were rocks. The movie theater? Also a rock. On the busy streets, decorative banners helped everyone tell the rocks apart.
panels.alt: Gray boulder businesses line a busy purple-and-yellow street with decorative banners.

panels.caption: A Yip wore a long hooded robe. Only a long, drooping nose, a full toothy smile, and bare toes escaped it. The eyes stayed completely hidden in shadow.
panels.alt: Close view of a Yip with a drooping nose, a broad toothy grin, and complete darkness beneath the brow of the hood.

panels.caption: Walking was a rapid, inch-by-inch shuffle of toes. It was surprisingly efficient. It was not especially dignified.
panels.alt: Bare toes shuffle rapidly under long robe hems.

panels.caption: Instead of water, they drank purple ploofidonk. They ate brog: a yellow substance shaped very much like a patty. Life had its essentials.
panels.alt: A smiling Yip raises a glass of purple ploofidonk beside a yellow brog patty.

panels.caption: Yips were musical creatures. They could greet, gossip, sing, and discuss lunch with one remarkably versatile word.
panels.alt: Five Yips with distinct purple-and-yellow robe markings enjoy brog together.

panels.caption: And so their peaceful little world went on. Yip after yip after yip.
panels.alt: A peaceful musical town of gray rocks settles into a purple-and-yellow sunset.

panels.caption: Until one day, a lime-green spaceship arrived. It looked an awful lot like a blimp.
panels.alt: A lime-green blimp-shaped spaceship casts an enormous shadow over the rock town.

panels.caption: Out came the Gorfs: great, green, translucent blobs of gooey acid. They carried small orange weapons that looked suspiciously like water pistols.
panels.alt: A large green Gorf, with bubbles and distorted scenery visible through its gelatinous body, holds a tiny orange pistol in a gooey protrusion.

panels.caption: Their voices were low, scary, and very British. Their manners were impeccable.
panels.alt: The translucent Gorf leader leans courteously toward a tiny smiling Yip.

dialogue.speaker: Gorf leader
dialogue.text: Could you take me to your leader?

panels.caption: The Yip shuffled toward the biggest Yip rock of all.
panels.alt: A Yip leads the enormous green Gorf up a winding street toward the largest gray rock.

panels.caption: The Gorf leader made a very respectful introduction.
panels.alt: Beneath the royal rock, the Gorf bows to the Yip leader on a purple-and-yellow throne.

dialogue.speaker: Gorf leader
dialogue.text: Good day, sir? Ma’am? Um… Royal Yip. Is there any way you would allow us to take over your planet?

panels.caption: A small request. Practically a favor.
panels.alt: The Gorf leader gestures politely with a tiny orange weapon while the Yip leader listens.

dialogue.speaker: Gorf leader
dialogue.text: I really don’t want to be a bother. I just need to destroy anything and everything on Flummoxprap.

panels.caption: The Yip leader considered this with all the vocabulary at their disposal.
panels.alt: The Yip leader beams a completely oblivious toothy smile.

panels.caption: So the Gorf went around town, checking with everyone individually. It was important to be polite.
panels.alt: The Gorf courteously visits smiling Yips along a street of gray rock homes.

panels.caption: But five Yips had learned something new.
panels.alt: Five Yips with a stripe, violet hem, zigzag, shoulder patch, and three dots face the Gorf as their smiles disappear.

panels.caption: From then on, those five were known as the Nerps. There were exactly five of them. Their enthusiasm had also left in a group.
panels.alt: The five gloomy Nerps stand shoulder to shoulder, refusing the towering translucent Gorf.

panels.caption: They looked much the same as Yips, except their mouths were now small, almost straight lines with a slight downward curve.
panels.alt: Close-up of the striped Nerp’s tiny downturned mouth, long nose, and shadow-hidden eyes.

panels.caption: They shuffled straight to their own spaceship.
panels.alt: Exactly five marked Nerps hurry on bare toes toward an enormous gray rock.

panels.caption: Their spaceship was, naturally, a comically oversized rock.
panels.alt: Five tiny Nerps climb a ramp into an absurdly large plain gray boulder spaceship.

panels.caption: The controls were reassuringly simple. Every button said “Yip”… except the big red one in the middle.
panels.alt: Purple-and-yellow controls surround a huge red central button.

panels.caption: One Nerp pressed the button with the sticker that read “Away.”
panels.alt: The striped Nerp presses the giant red button while the other four brace themselves.

panels.caption: And away they went.
panels.alt: The enormous gray rock spaceship blasts away from purple-and-yellow Flummoxprap.

panels.caption: The journey was long and quiet. Flummoxprap’s colors faded into the distance. The silence was occasionally interrupted by a grumbled…
panels.alt: A lonely gray rock travels through sweeping galaxies, with its home planet far behind.

panels.caption: As Earth grew closer, so did their hope of a new home. The Nerps were gloomy, but very smart. They suspected they would not be welcome.
panels.alt: Five gloomy Nerps look through their cockpit window toward Earth.

panels.caption: They contrived a plan. A plan consisting of three things.
panels.alt: The five Nerps huddle over a plan with three parts.

panels.caption: ONE: the button hidden in a drawer. The one marked “Invisibility.” Convenient, that.
panels.alt: An open cockpit drawer reveals a special purple-and-yellow button.

panels.caption: TWO: one inflatable sumo wrestler costume. Large enough for all five Nerps: one in each limb, and one in the middle as the head.
panels.alt: A cutaway shows five Nerps packed into a single inflatable costume: one per arm, one per leg, and one in the head and torso.

panels.caption: THREE: a weapon well known on Flummoxprap—THE LASER GUN! Unfortunately, they had not had time to pack a laser gun.
panels.alt: A Nerp looks into an empty equipment case where the laser gun should have been.

panels.caption: So they settled for a foam-dart gun. Since they could only say “Nerp,” that became its name. The Nerp gun.
panels.alt: The Nerps present a blue-and-yellow toy gun with an orange tip and three blunt foam darts.

panels.caption: Phase one: press the hidden button. Their enormous rock became a sneaky vehicle that nobody but the Nerps could see.
panels.alt: A sleeve presses the drawer button as the rock spaceship becomes an invisible outline above Earth.

chapters.title: Nothing unusual here
chapters.kicker: Five aliens. One very bad disguise.

panels.caption: They landed their invisible rock on the roof of a 7-Eleven in Japan. An entirely ordinary place to park a gigantic rock.
panels.alt: An invisible rock, indicated by a dotted outline for the reader, settles on a Japanese 7-Eleven roof.

panels.caption: Phase two: get five Nerps into one costume.
panels.alt: The five distinct Nerps stand on the roof beside one enormous empty inflatable costume.

panels.caption: This involved considerably more squishing than the plan had suggested.
panels.alt: Two Nerps struggle into the costume’s limbs while the other three wait.

panels.caption: Eventually, after several painful “Nerps,” all five fitted. More or less.
panels.alt: Five cramped Nerps fill the costume, one in each limb and one in the center.

panels.caption: They set off.
panels.alt: The inflated lumpy costume awkwardly squeezes through a rooftop stairway.

panels.caption: Their waddle was not remotely like a human walk. People stared. A great deal of the staring was deserved.
panels.alt: People in an ordinary Japanese shopping street give puzzled looks to the clumsy inflatable disguise.

panels.caption: Phase three: shoot anyone who discovered their true identity. They did not know a foam-dart gun could do little more than mildly annoy someone.
panels.alt: A hidden sleeve grips the colorful toy gun behind the inflatable costume.

panels.caption: Then they found an elevator. They decided to ride it up and down for fun. Even Nerps needed a hobby.
panels.alt: The lumpy costume approaches an elevator inside a city building.

panels.caption: An elderly man joined them. He could barely see, even with his glasses. As far as he could tell, he was sharing an elevator with a very large sumo wrestler.
panels.alt: The inflatable costume stands in an elevator beside an elderly man with thick glasses.

panels.caption: Up. Down. Up. Down. An excellent afternoon.
panels.alt: A Nerp’s sleeve reaches from the costume to press elevator buttons.

panels.caption: Until one head popped out.
panels.alt: The striped Nerp’s long-nosed hooded head accidentally protrudes from the inflatable costume.

panels.caption: Phase three! A direct hit!
panels.alt: A soft orange foam dart gently bounces off the elderly man’s cardigan without hurting him.

panels.caption: The man wondered what had just hit him. The Nerps wondered why he was still standing.
panels.alt: The elderly man peers in bewilderment through thick glasses at a harmless dart on the floor.

panels.caption: So they shot him again. And again. And again. He remained extremely un-defeated.
panels.alt: More soft foam darts bounce harmlessly off his cardigan and gather around his shoes.

panels.caption: Eventually, the doors opened and the man got out.
panels.alt: The elderly passenger calmly leaves at his floor as the inflatable costume watches.

panels.caption: Success! Perhaps he had been intimidated. But it was probably just his floor.
panels.alt: Alone in the elevator among scattered foam darts, the exposed Nerp looks perplexed and proud.

panels.caption: By the time they left, it was getting late. The five Nerps still had nowhere to stay.
panels.alt: The five Nerps, out of their disguise, search a quiet street at nightfall.

panels.caption: Then they saw it. On a quiet street, right beneath a small bridge: the perfect house.
panels.alt: A small, abandoned, faded navy-blue house huddles beneath a bridge behind a chipped white fence.

panels.caption: Faded navy-blue paint. A rusty white fence with chipped paint. A little patch of dead grass. And a large, crooked sign.
panels.alt: The five Nerps admire the gloomy house and its crooked fence sign.

panels.caption: They straightened the sign. Such a lovely message deserved to hang properly.
panels.alt: Two Nerps carefully straighten the warning sign while the other three supervise.

panels.caption: From outside, you could see through the big front window only when something was very close to it.
panels.alt: Seen from outside, the cloudy front window barely reveals the sofa immediately behind it.

panels.caption: From inside, you could see everything outside perfectly. The Nerps already loved the house’s rustic, sad feel.
panels.alt: From inside the house, the street is clearly visible through the same window.

panels.caption: Then they saw the rest of the inside. It was HUGE. At least five times the size the outside had suggested.
panels.alt: The tiny five Nerps stand in an impossibly vast interior with a sofa beside the front window.

panels.caption: One big sofa sat very close to the window. In the back-right corner, a dark doorway led to an enormous back room. The Nerps had an idea.
panels.alt: The five Nerps inspect the sofa by the window and a dark doorway in the back-right corner.

chapters.title: The waiting room
chapters.kicker: Ten seconds of very bad engineering

panels.caption: They huddled together and discussed it for a minute.
panels.alt: Exactly five gloomy Nerps huddle and point toward the dark back room.

panels.caption: Then they built their masterpiece. It took about ten seconds.
panels.alt: All five Nerps assemble an enormous conveyor machine in a flurry of tools.

panels.caption: A bin at the top, big enough for a whole human. A conveyor belt across the room. A table at the end for whatever came out.
panels.alt: The completed machine has an empty human-sized intake bin, a long conveyor, and an output table.

panels.caption: Their plan was simple and sinister: shoot anyone who trespassed until that person could no longer stand… or breathe. Then put the person into the machine.
panels.alt: The empty intake bin looms in shadow. There is no person in or near it.

panels.caption: Somehow, they expected a small brown cardboard box to come out. Inside it: one Nerp gun and three Nerp darts.
panels.alt: An open brown cardboard box on the output table contains one colorful toy gun and exactly three blunt orange foam darts.

panels.caption: The gun was still the same harmless foam-dart toy from the elevator. The Nerps’ intentions were another matter entirely.
panels.alt: The striped Nerp holds the harmless toy gun as the other four stand grimly beside the machine.

panels.caption: Satisfied with their work, the five returned to the front room. The sofa had space for them all.
panels.alt: The five distinct Nerps leave the dark workshop and approach the sofa beside the window.

panels.caption: And so the five Nerps sat together on the sofa… and waited for their first victim.
panels.alt: Exactly five gloomy Nerps sit in a row on one sofa directly behind the front window. No visitor comes. They wait in silence.
